name: browserbase
description: Cloud browser automation via Browserbase + Stagehand: navigate, act, observe, and extract structured data from any web page — no local Chrome required.
long_description: Wraps the official @browserbasehq/mcp server with zero-touch setup. Exposes 6 tools (start, end, navigate, act, observe, extract) backed by real cloud Chrome sessions. Bring your own Browserbase API key and project ID (free tier available); optionally set a model provider key for the act/observe/extract AI calls (Gemini by default, or any provider via modelName/modelApiKey).

tools.name: start
tools.description: Open (or reuse) a cloud browser session.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Load a URL in the current session.

tools.name: act
tools.description: Perform one interaction: click, type, select, scroll.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: List interactable elements matching a description.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Pull structured data out of the current page.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key
gemini_api_key.description: Powers the default model for act/observe/extract. Optional if you pass --modelName/--modelApiKey another way.
